subject: Diplograptus pristis
direct_observation: Personally re-viewed full original plate. Fig1E shows alternating tubes, long connecting interthecal surfaces, dark borders and bright triangular transmitted regions. Caption identifies etched non-compressed specimen photographed in transmitted infrared light, not a direct reflected-light photograph of empty air holes. Other compressed/cast panels show a continuous rhabdosome silhouette.
inference: Bright triangular regions cannot safely be modeled as true macroscopic windows. Earlier r004/r006/r008 models left unsupported air gaps between paired tubes and a central support. This was a maker interpretation error, not evidence for natural fenestration.
correction_plan: Replace central solid support with a continuous hollow common external tubarium envelope joining the two rows. Retain an undivided inner common cavity, not a median septum. Long interthecal walls remain distinct from the absent median septum. Exact envelope depth/thickness is reconstructive and not claimed measured from the infrared image. Preserve every true thecal mouth with real recess/exterior rays, and test every original-geometry attachment.

budget.scope: Same-subject thin-wall versus false-window factual repair and its final source, rebuilds,8views/sheet and compact manifests only.

original_freeze: Unchanged; this is explicit evidence-led implementation correction.
